challenges.title: Milestone 1: Repository Architecture & Clean Git Workflow
challenges.desc: Initialize your production repository with structured directory architecture, clean branching conventions, and semantic Git commits.

challenges.title: Milestone 2: Production Code Audit & Zero-Vulnerability Scan
challenges.desc: Run automated static AST security analysis on your codebase to ensure zero secrets leaks, clean dependency trees, and SHA-256 package checksum verification.

challenges.title: Milestone 3: Automated Test Suite & CI/CD Pipeline Setup
challenges.desc: Implement unit and integration test coverage with automated GitHub Actions / CI runner that enforces build pass criteria before release.

challenges.title: Milestone 4: Peer Code Review & Pull Request Verification
challenges.desc: Complete an end-to-end pull request cycle: conduct constructive peer review, verify type safety, and achieve approved merge status.

challenges.title: Milestone 5: Semantic Versioning & Package Publication
challenges.desc: Package your clean production codebase complying with SemVer 2.0 specs, generate automated release notes, and deploy version 1.0.0.

challenges.title: Milestone 6: Cryptographic Licensing & Escrow Delivery Token
challenges.desc: Configure automated encrypted hash token delivery, tamper-evident checksums, and verified instant source code delivery for buyers.
